title: Malicious code in slatejob (PyPI)
description: The PyPI package 'slatejob' version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign involving loader packages that download and execute remote malicious scripts. Although the package itself does not contain the payload, it acts as a delivery mechanism for potentially harmful code. This coordinated campaign aims to provide multiple deceptive methods to load malicious code remotely.
aiSummary: The 'slatejob' package on PyPI, specifically version 0.1.0, is identified as part of a malicious campaign that uses loader packages to execute code fetched from remote URLs. These packages do not embed the malicious payload directly but facilitate the execution of external malicious scripts. The campaign is coordinated and designed to deploy various deceptive loaders to execute malicious code remotely, posing a threat to users who install or use these packages.
aiImpact: Users who install or use 'slatejob' version 0.1.0 risk executing remote malicious scripts, which can lead to compromise of the affected system. The package acts as a loader, enabling attackers to run arbitrary code from external sources, potentially leading to data theft, system manipulation, or further malware deployment.
